title: Former Intel packaging chief Navid Shahriari joins MediaTek as senior vice president

MediaTek announced it has recruited former Intel Executive Vice President Navid Shahriari as Senior Vice President, effective November 9, reporting to President and Chief Operating Officer Joe Chen. Shahriari brings 37 years of experience in semiconductor design engineering and advanced packaging, having previously overseen Intel's back-end process operations, packaging and testing, and chiplet integration strategy. He will lead teams covering advanced process and yield, advanced testing and packaging, with one of his core missions being to deepen collaboration with supply chain partners including Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing to help MediaTek advance artificial intelligence and high-performance computing products. This marks MediaTek's second major talent move in advanced packaging, following its recruitment of former TSMC R&D Vice President Yu Chen-hua as an advisor in May this year.

Former Intel packaging chief Navid Shahriari joins MediaTek as senior vice president

MediaTek announced that Navid Shahriari will join the company on November 9 as Senior Vice President, reporting to the General Manager and Chief Operating Officer.
